mode.description: Controls how the agent phrases operator-facing messages. Gates are identical in both modes.

previewPublicUrl.description: Optional address to show the operator instead of a localhost URL.

gates.description: Object = run it. null = not applicable (confirmed). Missing = unknown; doctor asks the operator.

cmd.description: Command the gate runs; exit code 0 passes.

fix.description: Optional command that fixes what the gate reports (for example a formatter).

affected.description: Command run with the concern's changed files. Must use a simple static runner and contain one top-level {files} token outside quotes; shell command-evaluation templates are unsupported.

kind.description: web (a URL the toolkit checks), command (a demo command whose output the operator reads), or manual (instructions only).

cmd.description: Starts the web preview, or is the demo command for kind command.

url.description: Internal address the toolkit probes before presenting a web preview.

readyPattern.description: Optional output text that signals the preview command is ready.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the preview to respond or finish.

instructions.description: For kind=manual: how the operator sees the result.

screenshots.description: Capture desktop and mobile screenshots at preview time when Playwright is installed in the project.

screenshotPaths.description: Paths (relative to preview.url) to capture. Default ['/'].

updates.description: Controls the automatic upstream check performed by begin.

revision.description: Optional branch, tag, or commit to pin. null follows the remote default branch.

offline.description: allow (default) continues with the installed toolkit when upstream cannot be checked; fail blocks begin. A machine-local setting of the same name overrides it.

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time for each update network or installer subprocess.

source.description: Globs for product source; changes here need a test in the same batch.

docs.description: Globs for documentation; prose-only edits keep the verification receipt and review valid.

documentable.description: Paths whose behavior affects setup, commands, configuration, skills, or operations and therefore requires a documentation companion when changed. These paths do not count as product source and do not trigger source-test pairing.

generated.description: Generated output; edits are refused and it never counts as a change.

protected.description: Secrets and keys the agent must never edit or stage.

neverStage.description: Files that must never be saved (logs, env files, caches, backups).

allowDebug.description: Paths where debug output such as console.log is allowed.

maxAddedLinesPerFile.description: Largest number of lines one batch may add to a single source file.

requireTestPerSourceChange.description: Source changes need a changed or added test, or STAFF_ENGINEER_TEST_WAIVER.

requireDocsImpact.description: Source or documentable changes need a docs update, or STAFF_ENGINEER_DOCS_WAIVER.

maxConcernCategories.description: Source areas one batch may touch before needing STAFF_ENGINEER_BROAD_CHANGE_REASON.

requireSession.description: warn reports missing session discipline; block makes lifecycle require a finalized session and a current context packet; off disables both.

scope.description: changed checks weak assertions touched by the staged diff; all scans every staged test file in the repository.

testQuality.description: Test-quality scanning; scope changed (default) checks staged assertions only, all checks the whole test tree.

disable.description: Rule ids to turn off entirely.

ui.description: UI finish rules for user-facing file types (rules/ui.json).

importAliases.description: Import prefix to path prefix, e.g. {"@/": "src/"}.

lanes.description: Size limits per lane. A trivial concern that grows past them must move to the standard lane.

trivial.description: A trivial concern may touch at most maxSourceFiles source files and add maxAddedLines lines.

boundaries.description: Architecture boundary rules checked on newly added imports.
